events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place on this day in 1969, featuring legendary performances that defined a generation.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock! Which legendary performance still gives you chills?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to inspire generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation, 30 years on. His music and message still resonate. What's his most impactful lyric for you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road'! That album cover is instantly recognisable, but what's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine.' A song that still makes us think. What does it mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years since Apple changed how we listen to music. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who is your ultimate 007 and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world remembers legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring message
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring music and message of John Lennon. What's your favourite Lennon solo track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns another year older! An incredible double album with so many gems. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world pays tribute to the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Immortal Voice
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song with him on vocals?
